source.description: Reviewed handmade raster felt-tip-marker process contact sheet.
source.notes: One face-free upright walkie-talkie with radio-wave accents; no lettering, numbers, labels, arrows, UI, signatures, watermarks, hands, second device, sticker edge, badge frame, or decorative border.

process_strategy: Eight cumulative panels move from a sparse device box, antenna route, hardware ticks, screen reserve, and speaker placements to one stable walkie-talkie with complete marker map and a finishing-only final.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one upright rounded-box envelope, one center axis, one antenna route, two top-knob ticks, one side-button tick, one screen reserve, five speaker placements, and one broken shadow route.

anchor_map.early_mark: One upright rounded-box envelope with a center axis
anchor_map.becomes: One face-free upright walkie-talkie body with a gently tapered lower case
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The top stays narrower than the base, the device leans slightly right, and the same center axis, scale, and baseline remain fixed in every panel.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale open envelope and axis only in Panel 1; the case silhouette closes in Panel 2.

anchor_map.early_mark: One antenna route, two top-knob ticks, and one left-side button tick
anchor_map.becomes: One flexible antenna at top left, exactly two round top knobs, and one rectangular push-to-talk button on the upper-left case edge
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: All hardware remains attached to the same top or left case anchors and never floats, swaps sides, or changes count.
anchor_map.construction_note: Open route and ticks only until the hardware is shaped in Panel 3.

anchor_map.early_mark: One screen reserve and five horizontal speaker placements, with open paper reserved outside the antenna
anchor_map.becomes: One blank rounded screen, exactly five horizontal speaker slots, and exactly two signal arcs outside the antenna
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The screen stays centered in the upper case, the five slots remain a centered stack below it, and both later signal arcs stay in the reserved open paper outside the antenna tip without touching the device.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale reserve and placement marks only until Panel 4; the signal arcs first appear in Panel 5, and the screen remains blank with no text or numerals.

final_elements.name: device hardware screen speaker and shadow placement guides
final_elements.description: One open case envelope, center axis, antenna route, two knob ticks, one side-button tick, one screen reserve, five speaker placements, and one broken shadow route.

final_elements.name: upright walkie-talkie case silhouette
final_elements.description: One rounded upright case with a slightly narrower top and gently tapered lower body.

final_elements.name: antenna two knobs and push-to-talk button
final_elements.description: One top-left antenna, exactly two top knobs, and one attached upper-left side button.

final_elements.name: blank screen bezel and five speaker slots
final_elements.description: One blank rounded screen with one bezel and exactly five evenly spaced horizontal speaker slots below it.

final_elements.name: two signal arcs two highlights four grip ribs and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Exactly two radio-wave arcs, exactly two open-paper case highlights, exactly four lower grip ribs arranged two per side, and one broken navy shadow.

final_elements.name: black marker and complete teal coral yellow pale-aqua and navy color map
final_elements.description: Thick imperfect black outlines with a teal case, coral side button and knobs, yellow antenna accent and signal arcs, pale-aqua blank screen, and navy speaker slots and shadow.

final_elements.name: directional marker texture and small hardware accents
final_elements.description: Visible marker streaks, established bezel and hardware depth, highlight edges, grip ribs, and shadow texture.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The case silhouette stops around the antenna, two knob, and side-button anchors so later hardware attaches without erasing finished case lines.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The case interior remains blank at the screen reserve and five speaker placements; no decorative keeper line runs through those features.

final_step.visible_job: Only complete established marker fills, strengthen selected keeper contours, and clarify the same case, antenna, controls, blank screen, five speaker slots, two signal arcs, two highlights, four grip ribs, and shadow.
allowed_changes: small established hardware highlight grip and shadow accents

rejection_checks: Reject a detailed first panel, a drifting case lean, or an antenna, knob, or push-to-talk button that floats, swaps sides, changes count, or changes attachment.
Reject missing or extra devices, antennas, knobs, side buttons, screens, speaker slots, signal arcs, highlights, grip ribs, or shadows after those elements appear.
Reject any lettering, numerals, screen icons, face, hands, second radio, sticker edge, badge frame, or prop in any panel.
Reject vector-like fills, glossy poster rendering, repeated faint-to-dark tracings, labels, arrows, numbers, text, signatures, or watermarks.
